panels.description: Alex scans his identity band at the checkpoint; Foreman-7 stands beside the scanner, visibly human beneath his supervisory harness. Leave upper checkpoint space.
The band displays liability transfer and Adrian's whereabouts. Keep the display unobstructed.
The band displays the debt balance, projected clearance and travel restriction. Leave upper display space.
The shutter opens toward the closed, dust-covered Last Chance bar. Alex covers Adrian's watch with his thumb. Leave upper space.
